verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents call the Stripe API and search Stripe docs (docs-18, probe-4), so users can drive Stripe through an agent in natural language. The Financial Connections use-case page lists agent-powered spending analysis and balance/transaction monitoring via the Link CLI (docs-11). However, nothing shows that the MCP tools cover Financial Connections operations specifically. Missing for 10: confirmation that MCP tools cover Financial Connections operations (linking accounts, refreshing balances/transactions), detailed docs on natural-language operation of this product, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
